data.question: I'm having issues starting my air conditioner.
data.answer:
• Ensure the plug is pushed completely into the outlet. Appliances should be plugged directly into a wall outlet.
• Press the reset button on the plug to reset the current. If the reset button stays engaged, please unplug the unit and contact our support team.
• Check to see if your home's circuit breaker or fuse is working properly.

data.question: The air conditioner is dripping water outside.
data.answer: • In hot and humid weather this is normal.

data.question: The air conditioner is dripping water inside.
data.answer: • Make sure the unit is tilted backward slightly so excess water can drain outside.

data.question: Water is collecting in the base pan.
data.answer: • This is normal for a short time in areas with low humidity and normal for a longer time in areas with high humidity.  The water in the base pan is used to keep the appliance running efficiently.

data.question: My air conditioner is not as cool as it should be.
data.answer:
• Make sure there are no curtains, blinds, or furniture blocking the air intake.
• The air filter may be dirty. We recommend cleaning it and trying again once it has completely dried.
• Make sure to allow some time for the room to cool down after turning on the air conditioner.

data.question: The air conditioner is freezing up.
data.answer: • Set the mode to HIGH FAN or HIGH COOL and set the thermostat to a higher temperature.

data.question: My digital display reads "E1" or "E2".
data.answer: • Please contact our customer advocacy team using the "Contact Us" option located in the 'Service' tab.

data.question: The Filter LED is on and the filter has been cleaned.
data.answer: • The filter LED turns on as a reminder to check and clean the filter if necessary.  To turn it off hold down the button for a couple of seconds.
